name: Children Leaving Home
overview: Scripture teaches that children are a precious heritage from the Lord and that parents have a God-given responsibility to instruct and discipline them in His ways. As children prepare to leave home and establish their own households, they are called to leave their parents and cleave to their spouses, forming a new, unified family. God’s presence and strength are promised to guide them in this transition, while the foundation laid through parental guidance and correction helps ensure their steadfastness in the faith throughout life.
